name: Mukhyamantri Mahalaxmi Yojana
benefit: For pregnant woman- Almonds, kernels, Sukhi, Kumaoni, walnuts, dates, two pairs of socks, towel, blanket, shawl, bedsheet, sanitary napkin, mustard oil, nail cutter, soap and laundry soap. Girl Baby Materials - Baby Clothes, Cotton Nappies, Baby Towel Cotton, Baby Soap, Oil, Baby Powder, Rubber Sheet, Baby Blanket, Vaccination Card, Breastfeeding Nutrition Card.
eligibility_rules: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand state. She must be a pregnant woman. Only those pregnant ladies above 18 years of age would be eligible. The family and dependents of all government employees paying Income Tax would not be covered under the project.
documents_required: documentsIdentity Proof (Aadhar Card / Voter ID Card / Ration Card) Residence proof (any one of the house electricity bill, water bill,
ration card etc.)Age certificateCertificate of being pregnant (As a certificate, you can take the doctor's slip or card of the first aid center
or government hospital.)BPL ration cardRegistration at Anganwadi CenterCopy of government or private mother
(MCP card) Institutional Delivery Certificate (Certificate issued by Anganwadi worker/Asha worker or doctor) Self
for the birth of first, second / twin girl childCertificate of non
how_to_apply:
Mode: Offline Application Process There is no online process available to apply under Uttarakhand Mahalaxmi Yojana
• 2022. If the woman gives birth at home, then she will have to go to the Anganwadi or the nearest health centre and take the registration certificate. The woman has to attach the birth certificate of the daughter with the application form. To get the application form, you can take help from the Asha sister or the health worker posted in the health center. After taking the application form, you will have to fill all the information asked in it. After that you have to attach all the above-mentioned documents in it. After attaching the documents, you have to submit it to the concerned officer.
